import sys, json, time, numpy as np, random

def main():
    start = time.time()
    json_path = sys.argv[1]
    budget = float(sys.argv[2])
    with open(json_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    n = data["n"]
    A = np.array(data["A"], dtype=int)
    B = np.array(data["B"], dtype=int)
    best_perm = None
    best_cost = None
    best_time = None

    def cost(p):
        return int(np.sum(A * B[p][:, p]))

    def neighbor(p):
        i, j = random.sample(range(n), 2)
        p2 = p[:]
        p2[i], p2[j] = p2[j], p2[i]
        return p2

    p = list(range(n))
    cur_cost = cost(p)
    best_perm = p[:]
    best_cost = cur_cost

    t = 0.0
    while t < budget:
        t = time.time() - start
        if t >= budget:
            break
        p2 = neighbor(p)
        c2 = cost(p2)
        if c2 < cur_cost or random.random() < 0.001:
            p, cur_cost = p2, c2
            if best_cost is None or c2 < best_cost:
                best_cost = c2
                best_perm = p2[:]
                best_time = t

    perm_1based = [x + 1 for x in best_perm]
    print("PERMUTATION: " + " ".join(map(str, perm_1based)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
